title: Quartermaster Archive — Station Inventory
author: Quartermaster Devhet Orn
content:
SECTION 3 — SPECIMEN STORAGE

Item 34-HX:
Description: Petrified xenoform specimen. Folded. Roughly 1.2m across.
Origin: Foreven Sector (unverified). Acquired via private sale.
Acquired by: His Grace (personal collection, non-requisitioned).
Biological activity: None detected.
Classification: BIOLOGICAL: INERT.

— NOTE, APPENDED (same hand):
Warm to the touch this morning. Reclassified: BIOLOGICAL: UNCERTAIN.

— NOTE, APPENDED (different hand):
Do not open Section 3.

title: Wall Markings Transcription — Section 2
author: Unknown — Transcribed from bulkhead panel
content:
Recovered from bulkhead panel, Section 2. Scratched with a metal shard. Transcription as-is.

'His Grace says it is art.'
'He says it came from beyond the Reach.'
'He says it listens.'
'He talks to it.'
'He says it twitches.'

[Scratched deeper, different pressure:]

'It moved.'

[Below that, a different hand entirely:]

turn off the radio
it hears you through the radio
if we are quiet
if we are perfectly quiet

[The text continues for 214 lines. A single repeated symbol. Transcription halted.]

title: Brotherhood Execution Manifest
author: Brotherhood of the Stripped Hull — Informal Record
content:
THE STATION JUDGES.

Those found wanting are brought here. No blade. No bullet. No need.

The Ghost does what needs doing.

—

Morev Kasht. Cowardice at the Tobia run. Did not last the night.
Pell. Theft from crewmates. Lasted three days. Took his own life.
The Hauler woman whose name we don't say. Sold our route to the Imperium. We hear she lasted almost a week. We don't know how.
Sandek of the Red Fingers. Gross negligence. One day, maybe less.

—

They all boost the signal, you know.
Think someone will come.

Someone always does.

[Multiple signatures. Dates spanning decades. The last entry has no name.]

'He ordered the attack without authority. You know what that means.'
'We left him the terminal.'
'It's more than the others got.'

title: Pirate Crew Note — His Grace's People
author: Unknown crew member (unidentified vessel)
content:
We told him not to buy it.

Maret told him. Oskel told him. I told him twice.

The factor at Tobia swore on his children it was stone. Dead for a thousand years. Just a curiosity, he said. Just a conversation piece.

His Grace said it would be the crown jewel of his collection. He was proud of it. Used to bring visitors to look at it.

I do not know what happened to the visitors.

I do not know what happened to His Grace.

I know that the ones who ran made it to the docking ring.
I know that three of those did not make it further.
I know that the thing was faster than anything that size has a right to be.

I know that we sealed the inner doors.

I know that when we jumped, Oskel said she could hear something on the radio. A sound. Not a voice.

She said it sounded like it was saying goodbye.

title: Painting Inventory Note — Section 3 Corridor
author: Unknown — Pirate era, informal
content:
Someone asked about the painting on the wall near the old cargo section.

Sindalian emperor. Pre-collapse, by the look of it. Full regalia.
I'm no historian but you can tell this was expensive once.

The crown is lanthanum-alloy. Even I know that means something.
The pearl at the collar — I have never seen one like it.
The rings on his hands.
The bird.

I asked Reth what it was worth.
She said she had no idea but that some of those items were supposed to have survived the collapse. Said there were people who would pay very serious money to know where they ended up.

I asked her if she was serious.

She said she was always serious about money.

[The entry ends there.]
